Task Title: Finalize short-stay vs long-term accommodation model
Description: Define how rooms/accommodations are identified as short-stay, long-term, or eligible for both, including UI and database implications.
Acceptance Criteria: Approved classification/configuration model documented and implementable.

Description: Implement the approved data fields and configuration required to manage short-stay and long-term accommodation.
Acceptance Criteria: Admin can configure the approved accommodation classification without direct database editing.

Description: Allow admin to set the short-stay billing/booking interval as every X hours according to business policy.
Acceptance Criteria: Changing X changes allowed/calculated short-stay duration behavior consistently.

Description: Allow an active/eligible short-stay booking to be upgraded to long-term accommodation.
Acceptance Criteria: Authorized user can upgrade an eligible booking while preserving transaction history and recalculated commercial values.

Task Title: Prevent long-term downgrade to short-stay rate
Description: Enforce the rule that a long-term booking cannot be downgraded to obtain a short-stay rate.
Acceptance Criteria: System prevents prohibited downgrade/rate conversion and records attempted/approved changes appropriately.

Description: Provide administrator-configurable cancellation options rather than hard-coded cancellation policy.
Acceptance Criteria: Admin can configure available cancellation behaviors/options and system applies selected configuration.

Description: Enhance dashboard components so KPI/content presentation can be configured to client operational needs.
Acceptance Criteria: Approved dashboard widgets/KPIs display accurate data for the configured client view.

Description: Enhance revenue/payment reporting and visibility of admin-verified received payments.
Acceptance Criteria: Reports clearly distinguish payment status and verified received payments according to approved rules.
Dependency / Input: Revenue-recognition clarification if accounting basis is requested

Description: Refine the existing venue booking workflow for better configuration and operational usability.
Acceptance Criteria: Venue booking flow supports approved client variables and prevents inconsistent booking state.

Description: Replace fixed venue pricing/payment values with administrator-configurable business variables.
Acceptance Criteria: Authorized admin can update venue-related values without code changes and bookings use the active values.

Description: Create access/log-in history capturing user identity and timestamp for access events where technically available.
Acceptance Criteria: Authorized admin can review access history with user and timestamp.

Description: Log material booking changes including actor, timestamp, and changed data/action.
Acceptance Criteria: Material booking changes are traceable to user and time with before/after or action detail as designed.

Description: Log material payment-record changes and admin verification actions.
Acceptance Criteria: Payment creation/update/verification actions are traceable to user and timestamp.

Description: Validate modified workflows across supported phone, tablet/iPad, laptop, and desktop browser form factors.
Acceptance Criteria: Approved modified workflows are usable without blocking layout/function issues across agreed browsers/devices.

Description: Confirm that retained room availability, payment status, manual references, payment verification, and proof-of-payment functions remain operational after changes.
Acceptance Criteria: No critical regression in retained existing functions.

Description: Deploy tested enhancements to the client-provided server environment and validate application access.
Acceptance Criteria: Approved build is deployed and accessible in the client environment.

Description: Transition the system after Month 1 adjustments into the agreed monthly support arrangement.
Acceptance Criteria: Support channels, issue classification, and escalation process are active.
